question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.**

Waver between different opinions or actions
solution: The correct answer is **"Vacillate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Vacillate** means to keep changing your ideas or opinions about something, especially in a way that annoys other people. ((विचार या मत में) टुलमुल होना, डाँवाँडोल होना, प्रायः खीजते हुए आगा-पीछा करना) • **Example:** *Her mood **vacillated**__ between hope and despair.* • Waver between different opinions or actions means **"Vacillate."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Sway** means to move back and forth or to influence someone's opinion or decision. (झूमना, डोलना (धीरे-धीरे, दाएँ-बाएँ हिलना)) • **Example:** *"The wind made the trees sway."* • **Viaduct** means a bridge that carries a road or railway over a valley or other obstacle. (घाटी पर बना लंबा ऊँचा पुल (जिस पर से रेल की पटरी या सड़क गुज़रती है)) • **Example:** *"The train went over the viaduct to cross the river."* • **Thrifty** means showing care with money and avoiding waste. (कमख़र्च, किफ़ायती, किफ़ायतशार, मितव्‍ययी) • **Example:** *"She was thrifty and saved money by shopping at thrift stores."* 42:T9c6, The correct answer is **"Pessimist."**
